spans.s:
डमः A despised and mixed caste
(Dom).

1 Riot, tumult, affray.
--2
Petty warfare between villages.
--3
Terrifying an enemy by shouts and
gestures.
--रं Running away through
fear, rout.

डमरुः A sort of small drum,
shaped like an hour-glass and
generally used by Kāpālikas; (sometimes
regarded as n. also).

डामर a.
1 Terrific, dreadful,
awful; पर्याप्तं मयि रमणीयडामरत्वं
संधत्ते गगनतलप्रयाणवेगः

.
--2
Riotous, tumultuous.
--3
Resembling, having the appearance (i. e.
lovely, beautiful); रतिगलिते ललिते
[]
कुसुमानि शिखंडकडामरे (चिकुरे)

.
--रः
1 An uproar, rout, affray,
riot.
--2 The bustle and confusion
of festivity or strife.
--3 Any
surprising sight.
--4 N. of a mixed
caste.
